# Accounts (cms-admin)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`access-admin`](../../flows/access-admin/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Who can sign in to the admin console ([access-admin flow](../../flows/access-admin/FLOW.md)). Admins and the owner invite accounts and manage those below their rank.

## Techniques

A view (page) folder registered in `views/Views.registry.ts`; it reads data only through feature facades ([cms-admin rules](../../apps/cms-admin/RULES.md)). Row actions show only for actors who may use them; the invite dialog offers only roles below the actor's rank, never `public`, `reviewer` or `owner` (D6). Enable and Resend invite need no confirmation; Disable is a dialog that names the account (Q13).

## Technologies

React, TanStack Table through `@abyss/form-commons`, react-hook-form with Zod.

## Entry points

Route `/accounts`, page `AccountsPage`.

## Where to change what

A new column: `Account.columns.tsx`. A new row action: `AccountRowActions.tsx` (and its permission check). Role choice in the invite: `assignableRoles` in `InviteDialog.tsx`.
